bio: The home of Claudia and Riccardo, Il Piastrino is situated amid the beautiful Montefeltro hills. A long-held dream for this couple, which they nurtured for years, the restaurant has been embellished with each passing year and now boasts a magnificent contemporary decor that is in total harmony with the warm rustic nature of its surroundings. The restaurant’s crowning glory is Riccardo Agostini’s technical, creative cuisine, which showcases the best seasonal, regional ingredients. This chef’s dishes are complex and elaborate in style yet never overly fussy.
